FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Update packageId
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates Empire's Package ID to reflect the hefty refactoring, and force old compatibility patches to update.

patchNoteLines.li: Update packageID Saakra.Empire -> Matatahias.Empire, and update other namespaces accordingly. This will "break" compatibility patches that target old Empire, but this is intentional, as those old patches are unlikely to work anyways.
